item.title: Modern plays for modern times: Great Barrington Public Theater’s seventh season moves to Saint James Place
item.description: 'We're not here to perform 'Charley's Aunt' or 'The Importance of Being Earnest'; we're here to do new plays that the audience has never seen before,' said Artistic Director Jim Frangione.

item.title: INTERVIEW: Arcis Saxophone Quartet returns to Linde Center with Bach-inspired program on March 22
item.description: The Munich-based ensemble returns to the Linde Center with a program pairing Bach fugues with contemporary preludes, creating a musical conversation between Baroque counterpoint and modern composition.

item.title: Where are the unifiers?
item.description: Historically, the leaders most admired are those who unified deeply divided societies. Today, however, division has become a tool of mobilization.
